## J2ME-NXX v0.8.13

- Fixed a crash when pressing B on the Send game (Wi-Fi upload) or Share screen while the Switch has no Wi-Fi connection.
- Fixed games sent over Wi-Fi not showing up in the app list when the file name has accented or non-Latin characters (e.g. Vietnamese "nhẹ"). The file name is now saved without accents (e.g. "nhẹ" → "nhe"); the game's display name is unchanged.
